title: Giltrap
html_source:
As we learn later in Nausicaa, Gerty’s grandfather, named Giltrap, owns a dog named Garryowen, the same name as the dog in Cyclops…so the Citizen is plausibly Gerty’s grandfather.

James J. Giltrap was also the actual owner of a champion dog named Garryowen in Joyce’s time.
